title: व्याकरणिक र कोशीय संसक्ति र सम्बद्धन Byakaranik ra Koshiya samsakti ra Sambadhwan
nepali: सङ्कथन अभिव्यक्तिको सिङ्गो कथन हो । यसमा भाषाका सम्पूर्ण एकाइहरू समाविष्ट भएका हुन्छन् । सम्पे्रषणमूलक हुनु सङ्कथनको प्रमुख विशेषता हो । यसमा गफ, कुराकानी, संवाद, छलफल, अन्तर्वार्ता आदि अन्तक्र्रियात्मक कथन अभिव्यक्तिका साथै एकालापीय अभिव्यक्तिहरू भाषण, प्रवचन, वाचन आदि पनि पर्दछन् । त्यस्तै गरी लेख्य रूपका निबन्ध, चिठी, संस्मरण, जीवनी, विज्ञापन, प्रतिवेदन, सूचना आदि पनि सङ्कथनकै विषय मानिन्छन् । सङ्कथनका भाषिक एकाइलाई अन्वितिपूर्ण बनाउन सम्बद्धक (ऋयजभकष्यल) र सम्बद्धन (ऋयजभचभलअभ) को बढी आवश्यकता पर्दछ । सम्बद्धकलाई संसक्ति पनि भनिन्छ । आपसमा जुटेर रहनु वा टाँसिएर रहनु नै संसक्ति हो । शब्द, पदावली, उपवाक्य र वाक्यका बिचमा सम्बन्ध स्थापित गराउने वा जोड्ने युक्तिहरू नै संसक्ति हुन् । यिनीहरूलाई व्याकरणिक र कोशीय गरी दुई वर्गमा बाँड्न सकिन्छ । सम्बद्धन सङ्कथनको आत्मा हो जुन भाषाको अर्थ पक्षसँग सम्बन्धित हुन्छ । सम्बद्धनले अभिव्यक्तिको वैचारिक सिलसिला जनाउँछ । वाक्यहरूबिच रहेको अन्तरसङ्गति अर्थात् भाव वा अर्थको सिलसिलाबद्ध प्रस्तुति नै सम्बद्धन हो । यसरी सम्बद्धक (संसक्ति) र सम्बद्धनको उपयुक्त मेलबाट मात्रै भाषिक अभिव्यक्ति सार्थक बन्न सक्ने देखिन्छ ।
american_english: Discourse is a unified utterance of expression. All units of language are incorporated within it. Being communicative is the primary characteristic of discourse. Within it fall interactive spoken expressions such as gossip, conversation, dialogue, discussion, and interviews, as well as monologic expressions including speeches, lectures, and recitations. Likewise, written forms such as essays, letters, memoirs, biographies, advertisements, reports, and notices are also regarded as subjects of discourse. To make the linguistic units of discourse harmonious, cohesion and coherence are greatly required. Connectives are also called cohesion. Existing joined together or sticking together is cohesion itself. The devices that establish relationships between or link words, phrases, clauses, and sentences are cohesion. These can be divided into two classes: grammatical and lexical. Coherence is the soul of discourse, which is related to the semantic aspect of language. Coherence denotes the conceptual sequence of expression. The internal consistency between sentences, that is, the sequential presentation of sense or meaning, is coherence. Thus, it is evident that linguistic expression can become meaningful only through a proper combination of cohesion and coherence.
british_english: Discourse is an entire utterance of expression. All units of language are subsumed within it. Being communicative is the foremost characteristic of discourse. In it are included interactive spoken expressions such as chat, conversation, dialogue, discussion and interviews, as well as monologic expressions such as speeches, lectures and recitations. Likewise, written forms such as essays, letters, memoirs, biographies, advertisements, reports and notices are also considered subjects of discourse. To render the linguistic units of discourse harmonious, cohesion and coherence are of greater necessity. Connectives are also termed cohesion. Cohesion is, in itself, holding together or adhering to one another. Cohesion consists of the devices that establish relations between or connect words, phrases, clauses and sentences. These can be classified into two categories: grammatical and lexical. Coherence is the soul of discourse, which relates to the semantic dimension of language. Coherence signifies the conceptual progression of expression. Coherence is the internal consistency among sentences, that is to say, the orderly presentation of thought or meaning. In this way, it appears that linguistic expression can become meaningful only through an appropriate union of cohesion and coherence.
australian_english: Discourse is a complete utterance of expression. All units of language are included within it. Being communicative is the main feature of discourse. It takes in interactive spoken expressions like gossip, chats, dialogue, discussion and interviews, along with one-way expressions like speeches, lectures and recitals. In the same way, written forms such as essays, letters, memoirs, biographies, advertisements, reports and notices are also treated as part of discourse. To make the language units of discourse work together harmoniously, cohesion and coherence are especially needed. Connective devices are also called cohesion. Cohesion simply means sticking together or being joined to one another. Cohesion refers to the devices that build links between or join words, phrases, clauses and sentences. These can be split into two groups: grammatical and lexical. Coherence is the soul of discourse, which links directly to the meaning side of language. Coherence points to the conceptual flow of expression. Coherence is the internal harmony between sentences, that is, the orderly presentation of sense or meaning. That way, it is clear that language expression can only become meaningful through a proper match between cohesion and coherence.
informal_english: Discourse is the whole package of expression, eh. Every single unit of language is packed inside it. Being communicative is the main thing about discourse. It covers back-and-forth talk like gossiping, having a yarn, dialogues, discussions and interviews, plus one-way talk like speeches, lectures and readings. Same goes for written stuff like essays, letters, memoirs, life stories, ads, reports and notices, which all count as discourse too. To get the language units in discourse hanging together properly, you really need cohesion and coherence. Connectives get called cohesion as well. Sticking together or holding onto each other is what cohesion is all about. Cohesion just means the tricks that hook up and join words, phrases, clauses and sentences. You can split them into two groups: grammatical and lexical. Coherence is the very soul of discourse, tied right to the meaning side of language. Coherence shows the train of thought running through expression. It's that internal fit between sentences, meaning the smooth flow of sense or meaning. So looking at it, language expression can only really make sense when you get a proper blend of cohesion and coherence.
